No dispute on FARE-1: there is no surge and every billed head is a disclosed one (F6, F7). This case is not about hidden add-ons; it is about 4.54 km of mileage billed from an unexempted deviation (F3, F4).

Agreed, and the rider does not allege any safety event; the chat is a plain route exchange (F8, F9) and the record discloses no incident, injury or dangerous-driving allegation, so SAFE-1/SAFE-2 are not engaged.

The segment's shape is as the rider states (F3), but 'nothing exempts it' is not established: a rider message sent at 18:47, before the segment began at 18:50, agreed to the driver's named-road reroute (F8, F9), and RD-5 exempts what the rider agreed to unless the record places the segment elsewhere (G13).
